title_en: Re-posted: Korea Polar Research Institute Postdoctoral Researcher Recruitment, Second Half of 2026
summary: The Korea Polar Research Institute (KOPRI) has re-posted its recruitment of postdoctoral researchers (연수연구원) for the second half of 2026. Interested applicants should consult the recruitment page at https://kopri.recruiter.co.kr/career/jobs/135009 for details. The deadline is Friday, 4 December, 18:00.
applies_to: Not stated in the notice. This is a re-posted recruitment notice for postdoctoral researchers at the Korea Polar Research Institute (KOPRI), and applying is optional. Eligibility requirements are not given in the notice itself; they may be on the linked recruitment page, which was not read.

dates.what: Deadline for the KOPRI postdoctoral researcher recruitment (re-posted notice)
dates.when: Friday, 4 December, 18:00 (the year is not written in the date; the notice concerns the second half of 2026)

steps: Visit the KOPRI recruitment page at https://kopri.recruiter.co.kr/career/jobs/135009 and read the full posting. Its content was not included in this notice and was not read.
Follow the instructions on that page before the deadline of Friday, 4 December, 18:00.
translation:
Title: Re-posted Notice: Recruitment of Postdoctoral Researchers (연수연구원, 박사후) at the Korea Polar Research Institute, Second Half of 2026 (until Friday, 12/4, 18:00)

Recruitment notice URL: https://kopri.recruiter.co.kr/career/jobs/135009

(The notice contains only the title and the link above. The content of the linked page was not read.)
